source: Owner: transient-flight modules including electronics <=4.5 kg excluding lift module; aim for 3.5 kg for hovering modules.

transfer.description: Short flights transporting the complete attached floor-cleaning assembly, such as stairs

sofa_transfer_policy: Owner-confirmed floor-resident attachments: one duplicate extension at each floor station. Park it and restore the normal vacuum head before flight. Include the normal vacuum, core, battery and all retained quick-change hardware; exclude parked extensions. The historical complete low bottom remains classified as transfer only for comparison.
included: Complete electronics/sensor core, structure, wiring, locks and core-side interfaces
Installed battery cells, cartridge, receiver, protection and all onboard energy-storage hardware outside the lift module
Complete attached cleaning bottom, including its drive hardware, mounts, actuators, connectors and retained/deployed tools
Maximum permitted operating load of debris, retained dust, water and wet cleaning media
Installation and completion allowances until replaced by documented finished parts
excluded: Complete physically separate lift module, which must have its own full installed mass ledger
Cap only when removed and replaced by the lift module
Equipment and spare packs physically left at a station
interpretation: Both classes use the same boundary: everything carried except the complete lift top. The 3.5 kg hover value is the current design target, distinguished from the explicit 4.5 kg transfer maximum. A multi-role configuration must meet the stricter target when used for sustained hover.
accounting_rule: Actual all-up flight mass = budgeted non-lift assembly + complete lift module. Give each physical item one owner; relabeling carried core/tool hardware as lift is not a mass reduction. Include any extra pack carried for that mission.
comparison_rule: Show nominal hardware with usual and maximum modeled contents separately. Also show the upper hardware estimate when defined. Passing an estimated budget is not measured compliance or a demonstrated thrust/endurance result.
design_rule: Keep unallocated headroom for unfinished hardware and uncertainty. Do not spend the entire difference to the ceiling or silently reduce battery, water/bin capacity, guards, cleaning performance or automated exchange to claim compliance. No additional percentage reserve is imposed by this configuration.
